title: When the Portrait Sings
author: Vesper Montrose
blurb: Isandro Ashgrove, a property surveyor appraising a house that appraises back, keeps the lights on and the doors counted. Then the excavation crew unearths a door, sealed from the inside — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must learn the song's last verse without singing along, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
